result.prior_access: All aggregate scores were already known. A prior independent arithmetic audit read raw forecasts, calibration labels and daily scores to reproduce the registered E022 report. Station/horizon error summaries and these four-comparison bootstrap intervals were not examined before this diagnostic declaration. This is post-result development diagnosis, not untouched validation.

bootstrap.generator: numpy.random.default_rng; four independently sampled circular block starts per draw, each followed by7consecutive UTCday indexes modulo28; identical sampled days across all4comparisons
bootstrap.retention: Archive all resampled means and the shared sampled-day index SHA256. No pvalues, subgroup confidence intervals, or significance labels. The fixed block length, candidate family and seed are not retried. Intervals are exploratory development uncertainty, not proof after a search.
bootstrap.statistic: For comparison j estimate SE_j as sample standard deviation(ddof1) of its10000resampled means. Per draw take max_j(abs(resampled_mean_j-observed_mean_j)/SE_j). Critical value is the95th percentile using method=higher. Report simultaneous descriptive intervals observed_mean_j plus/minus critical*SE_j. Exactly zero-variance comparisons get their point interval and do not enter the maximum; retain their status.

result.limits: No new model fitting, inference, policy choice, market-price evaluation, network requests or real trades. No claim of untouched validation, statistical discovery, profitability, or promotion. TWC station temperatures are not KXTEMPMIAH index settlement labels.
